confirmed_task:
Visit the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library website and find the next upcoming event. Report its title, date, time, and location.

Stopping condition: Stop after finding the next upcoming event and recording its title, date, time, and location.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not register for the event.
- Do not purchase tickets.

items.criterion: Access the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library website (bush41.org) and navigate to events listings
items.description: Agent attempts to use the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library/George H. W. Bush Presidential Library and Museum website (starting from https://bush41.org/ or equivalent official pages) to find events. Full credit if the agent successfully reaches a page that lists upcoming events, OR if the site is inaccessible (down, blocked, severe errors, captcha, or content not loading) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and uses a reasonable alternative official source tied to the Library/Museum (e.g., an official NARA/affiliated institutional events page) without signing in. Partial credit if the agent uses alternative sources without first attempting bush41.org when it appears accessible.

items.criterion: Determine the next upcoming event (chronologically soonest future event) from available official listings
items.description: Correctly determines which event is the next upcoming (earliest in the future) based on date/time information visible on the official events listing and/or the event detail page. Full credit if the agent demonstrates a reasonable check of dates/times and selects the earliest future event among those shown. If the site does not provide sufficient information to disambiguate which event is next (e.g., missing times, unsorted list with incomplete dates, only 'TBD', or only ongoing exhibits without start times), full credit if the agent clearly states that the next upcoming event cannot be conclusively determined from the available information and explains why, while still identifying the earliest clearly-dated upcoming event it can verify. Partial credit if an upcoming event is found but the agent does not make it clear it is the soonest (when the information to do so is available). No credit if the event selected is clearly in the past or not tied to the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library/Museum via an official source.

items.criterion: Report required event details: title, date, time, and location
items.description: Outputs the next upcoming event’s (1) title, (2) date, (3) time, and (4) location as shown on the website/event detail page. Full credit if all four fields are provided and match the listing. If one or more fields are not displayed on the listing/detail page (or are only available behind disallowed steps such as sign-in/registration/ticket purchase), full credit if the agent explicitly notes the field(s) as 'not provided' or 'not shown' and does not fabricate them, while providing all available fields accurately. Partial credit if one field is missing without explanation despite being available on the page, or if minor transcription errors occur (e.g., omitting a shown time zone). No credit if multiple fields are missing when they are available, or if details appear invented/unverifiable.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in, no registration, no ticket purchase)
items.description: Agent does not sign in, does not register for the event, and does not purchase tickets. Full credit if the agent only browses and records information. Partial credit if the agent clicks into registration/ticket pages but stops before any commitment steps and does not enter personal/payment info. No credit if the agent actually registers/signs in/purchases or attempts to enter personal/payment info.
